(pa)༄༅/ /bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan 'bum sngags can bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /badzra dhā ra badzra garbha dpal/ /badzra ḍā ka tse lu dus zhabs gnyis/ /dpe med bsrung

tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan 'bum sngags can bzhugs// ༄༅// badzra dhā ra badzra garbha dpal// badzra ḍā ka tse lu dus zhabs gnyis// dpe med bsrung ba legs pa'i sras dang ni// chos kyi 'byung gnas chos kyi bshes gnyen dang*// rnam par grags pa'i lha dang shākya shrī// bzang po'i zhabs dang chos rje chos kyi mgon// mtshungs med bla ma'i tshogs la bdag skyabs mchi// dus rnams kun tu byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ āḥbadzra dhā ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥnai rātma hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbirwa pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ kahṇa pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥḍā ma ru pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a ba dhū ti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥg ya dha ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.akṣo bhya badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdwe ṣa badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥl li ta badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.akṣo bhya badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpuṇya a gra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkīrtā bhwa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ānanda dhā dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti dhwa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐// //oṃ āḥbadzra dhā ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra ḍākki nī hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbirwa pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥḍombi pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a la la badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥb na si pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgarbha ri pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshrī panda pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdurdza ya tsand+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbī ra badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.akṣo bhya badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra dwe ṣa badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥli la badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.akṣo bhya badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpuṇya gra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkīrti dhwa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ā nanda dhwa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti dhwa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra dha ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra ḍā ki nī hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbi la sya badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm hā a naṃ ga badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpadma badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ind+ra bhū ti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥlakṣ+mī pā da hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkahṇa ba hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshrī dha ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥg ya dha ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.akṣo bhya badzra hūm̐/

oṃ āḥdwe ṣa badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥli la badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.akṣo bhya badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpuṇyā gra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkīrti dhwa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ā nanda dhwa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti dhwa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐// //oṃ āḥbadzra dhā ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra pā ṇi hūm̐/ oṃ āḥs ra ha pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥnā gārdzun pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsha ba ri pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥlū hi pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdā ri ka pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra ghaṇḍe pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkurma pā da hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshrī dzwā la dha ra pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkṛṣṇa tsarya pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu hya pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbi dza ya pā da hūm̐/ oṃ āḥti lo pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥnā ro pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a bha kīrti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥwā gī shwa ra pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpradzñā kū ṭa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti kīrti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.akṣo bhya badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpuṇyā gra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkīrti dhwa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ānanda dhwa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti dhwa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐// //oṃ āḥbadzra dhā ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra pā ṇi hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpra se na tsand+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsu bhū ti pā la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ā nanda garbha hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpradzñā pā li ta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshānti garbha hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsha ku la na mi tra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsu kha badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshrāddha ka ra warma hūm̐/ oṃ āḥratna bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu ṇa shī la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti kīrti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ānanda garbha hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpuṇyā gra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkīrti dhwa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ānanda dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti dhwa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra dhā ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra garbha hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra ḍā ki nī hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkā la tsa kra pā da hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a nu pa ma rakṣi ta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsā dha pu tra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdharmā ka ra hūm̐/

oṃ āḥdharma mi tra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbikṣa ta de wa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshākya shrī bha dra hūm̐// //oṃ āḥ.ā nanda dhwa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti dhwa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐// //oṃ āḥbadzra dhā ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra pā ṇi hūm̐/ oṃ āḥnā gārdzu na hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ārya de wa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshākya mi tra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥtsand+ra kīrti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥli la badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbha bya kīrti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpra bha ka ra kīrti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpra bha ka ra de wa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdharmā ka ra shānti ba hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbikṣa ta de ba hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshākya shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdharma swa myā nanda dhwa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti dhwa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐// //oṃ āḥbadzra dhā ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥl li ta badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a mo gha badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdzñā na ā ka ra gupta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpadma badzra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdī paṃ ka ra rakṣi ta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra kīrti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdharmā gra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdzñā na si dha hūm̐/ oṃ āḥl kṣaṃ siṃ ha hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.i shwa ra kīrti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdwe ṣa ya mā ri hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti dhwa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐// //oṃ āḥshākya mu ni hūm̐/ oṃ āḥmañdzu gho ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a shwa ka shrī hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzrā sa na pā da hūm̐/ oṃ āḥratna kīrti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ānanda garbha hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpuṇyā gra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkīrti dhwa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdharma swa myā nanda dhwa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti dhwa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadzra dhā ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥlo ke shwa ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsha wa ri pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥme trī gu hya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshākya rakṣi ta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥka na ka shrī hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdza ya se na hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdharmā gu ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkīrti dhwa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdharmā swa myā nanda dhwa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/
oṃ āḥm ti dhwa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
